title: Final Pressure Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the lowest pressure p_p must be correctly derived as p_p = (Q R T_R) / (L V).

title: Final Temperature Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the corresponding temperature T_He must be correctly derived as T_He = (1 + (R T_0 / L) ln(p_0 / p_p))^(-1) T_0.

title: Correct Numerical Estimates
description: Important Criteria: The numerical estimates for p_p and T_He must be calculated correctly using the provided values.

title: Clausius-Clapeyron Application
description: Important Criteria: The application of the Clausius-Clapeyron equation must be correctly stated and integrated to find T_He.

title: Assumptions Justification
description: Optional Criteria: The assumptions made regarding the constancy of boiling temperature and neglecting v_l should be clearly justified.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect application of the ideal gas law or Clausius-Clapeyron equation will result in a deduction.
